executive_assessment.text: New local coverage includes 2024 floods in named prefectures and scenario-based flood damages in six cities; modeled adaptation is not actual performance.
The CCDR reports both a northern resource-pressure/tension mechanism and education-adaptation barriers from instability/costs, while the health-plan gap is financial.

geographic_notes.text: Source dated 2025-02-27 reports: In 2024, flood waves in Siguiri, Kouroussa, Kankan, Mandiana and Gueckedou disrupted livelihoods and required humanitarian assistance.

Source dated 2025-02-27 reports: An August 2024 DREF allocation of CHF 467,835 supported Guinea Red Cross aid for 13,300 flood-affected people in Kankan region over four months, including cash, health, WASH and protection/accountability services.

Under SSP3-7.0 for 2050, the CCDR models urban flood damage increases without adaptation in six named cities; with modeled adaptation, increases are smaller, and Conakry/Kamsar losses fall below their historical baselines.

known_gaps.text: The climate knowledge portal page and 2026 national adaptation plan could not be substantively opened; neither is used as claim evidence.
The CCDR fragility statement is qualitative and does not estimate a climate-caused conflict effect.
Government-reported flood impacts and proposed adaptation measures were not independently validated.
Draft collection pending human source review and approval. IDA eligibility is not an FCV classification.
National and selected local examples do not establish district-level coverage or causal attribution.
The bank contains no completed mediated climate-FCV pathway; this is an evidence gap, not evidence of absence.
The official 2026 National Adaptation Plan record was accessible, but its linked PDF returned an internal retrieval error; no claims were drawn from metadata or search-indexed text.
The WFP Climate Response Analysis page provided only an abstract; its PDF link returned an HTML/error response, so the analysis was not used.
A UNOWAS study surfaced local farmer-pastoralist and water-competition material for Beyla and Boké/Boffa, but the original PDF returned HTTP 403; indexed excerpts were excluded.

The CCDR supplies contextual climate-fragility links and reported adaptation-implementation barriers, but the inspected sources do not establish event-level causal effects or document acute conflict disrupting aid delivery or climate services.
Named prefecture floods and modeled city impacts provide different types of local detail; neither supplies a full household-risk ranking.
Draft extension: human source review and approval remain pending. Lending eligibility is not an FCV classification.
